description: **Napoleon follow-ups of W26** (napoleon-remastered, not the core): (a) `tools/verbs/setup.py` calls `warscape.worktrees.report(root, rows, branches)` and prints its lines as warnings (dead worktree registrations, merged worktrees, a `.git` above the clone); (b) `wsc.toml` `[jobs] pc_state` set to the adapter's PC state folder, so a cloud session is not handed a `needs_pc` build; (c) its CLAUDE.md "pick up the next job" line says `jobs next` now claims the branch (no "push early") Why: the core ships the function, the key and the claim; the wiring is the game's (W26 decisions 7 and 10) Raised: W26 report, 2026-11-04
title: Napoleon follow-ups of W26
